# for_Figure6_siFbl_vs_siCtrl
To set up the embironment, please see another file; for_Figure1.Rmd

## 1. read rnk file
```{r}
GLT_rank_siFbl <- read.table("GLT_associated.rnk", header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```

## 2. obtain gmt file from the web
In this analysis, GO.CC was used
```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
gmt_cc <- read.gmt("https://data.broadinstitute.org/gsea-msigdb/msigdb/release/2025.1.Mm/m5.go.cc.v2025.1.Mm.symbols.gmt")
```

## 3. GSEA
```{r}
#prepare data
geneList <- GLT_rank_siFbl$V2
names(geneList) <- GLT_rank_siFbl$V1
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)
geneList <- geneList[!duplicated(names(geneList))]

# set random seed
set.seed(123)
Fig6_CC_GSEA <- GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE = gmt_cc, pvalueCutoff = 1)
Fig6_CC_GSEA@result <- Fig6_CC_GSEA@result[
  Fig6_CC_GSEA@result$qvalue < 0.25, 
]
```

check results
```{r}
head(Fig6_CC_GSEA@result)
```

## 4. Draw Dot plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
df_cc <- as.data.frame(Fig6_CC_GSEA)
df_cc$x <- 1

# Pathway名を変更
df_cc$Description <- gsub("GOCC_", "", df_cc$Description)
df_cc$Description <- sapply(strsplit(df_cc$Description, "_"), function(x) {
  
  x <- tolower(x)
  
  x <- sapply(x, function(word){
    if (word == "of") {
      "of"
    } else if (word == "snrnp"){
      "snRNP"
    } else {
      paste0(toupper(substring(word, 1, 1)), substring(word, 2, nchar(word)))
    }
})
  
  paste(x, collapse = " ")
})
```



```{r}
#Sort NES value
df_cc <- df_cc[order(df_cc$NES), ]
p <- ggplot(df_cc, aes(x = 1, y = reorder(Description, NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs(NES), color = NES)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "NES") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 32) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")) + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Pathway") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.5), breaks = c(0.5, 1, 1.5)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

# save
ggsave(
  filename = "Fig6_GSEA_dotplot.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 12,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("Fig6_GSEA_dotplot.png")
```

## 5. Draw enlichment plot

```{r}
library(enrichplot)
```

Draw the plots for the selected pathways;
 U2_SNRNP,TRANSLATION_INITIATION_FACTOR_3, up: INTERMEDIATE_FILAMENT, NUCLEOLUS
```{r}
pathways <- c("Intermediate Filament", "Nucleolus", "U2 snRNP", "Eukaryotic Translation Initiation Factor 3 Complex")
```

```{r}
for (pathway in pathways) {
  
  id <- which(df_cc$Description == pathway)
  nes <- df_cc[id, "NES"]
  qval <- df_cc[id, "qvalue"]
  
  print(
    gseaplot2(Fig6_CC_GSEA, 
              geneSetID = df_cc[id, "ID"], 
              title = paste0(pathway, "\nNES = ", round(nes, 2), ", q =", round(qval,3))
    )
  )
}
```
